portion_doctrine: Segments 1-10 are primarily game development video transcripts mixed with a Threads/LinkedIn social feed. The actual actionable content spans Blender/Unity character import workflows, Unreal Engine 5 MCP server setup (7-gate automation skill), multiplayer game mechanics (InstantDB/Firefly), and level design in Unreal. Heavy boilerplate social media noise in seg_001-seg_002. Useful precision starts seg_003+ (Unreal MCP tutorial, game dev patterns). No world-building doctrine, character creation principles, or narrative/lore frameworks present in these segments. Content is tool-focused (Blender, Unity, Unreal, Claude Code automation), not creative direction.
operating_rules: Unreal MCP 7-Gate Setup Skill: Prerequisites (Epic Launcher, C++, Python 3.12+, UV) → Clone repo → Build plugin → Wire to Claude Code → Live test → Troubleshoot
Game dev prompt pattern: Pre-flight check > ask what to build > plan in plan-mode > execute via MCP tools > verify and iterate
Sound design: Background music 20-30% volume, SFX 50%, major events louder; use open-source libraries or generate via Suno/MCP

Terrain setup: Create 3D terrain, lower scale (height critical), raise baseline, add layers (grass/textures), paint with brushes, add prefab ground details (rocks/gravel), trees via tree-tab or manual placement, grass via terrain-grass-system or detail-mesh, apply post-processing (bloom, color adjustments, vignette, lift-gamma-gain)

Character animation retargeting: Copy animations via generic-retarget-animation-blueprint + IK retargeter map; use skeleton-mesh tags to map source to target (mannequin to Echo model); disable source visibility with Always Stick Pose enabled
Movement controls: Discrete 4-direction movement needs to support 360-degree loops (not capped rotation); implement full-circle hold response for WASD

Multiplayer via InstantDB: Create app > copy public app ID > pass docs to agent > implement auth (email signin, no Google auth initially) > game state stored in realtime DB > creator spawns game, other players join, both see updated player positions

Level design integration: Override world game-mode (GM_Sandbox for motion-matching), add player-start, set post-process (exposure -5 to -1 range, disable bloom if >4 intensity), use complex-as-simple collision for foot alignment, light ray/debris cleanup before spawning mechanics
